When my crush is happy, everyone at school floats.
When she's sad, everything gets heavy.
So the principal gave me one rule: keep Rose calm. The ceiling is very hard.
Never watch her face. Watch the ceiling.
On Monday, I told her a joke in the hallway.
She didn't even smile. Then the whole hallway hit the ceiling.
Best ten seconds of my life. Then we all fell down.
So I stopped telling jokes. She called me boring. The gym got so heavy, the floor cracked.
So I told one tiny joke.
So I said nothing. I just sat next to her.
She didn't move. Every lunch tray in the cafeteria flew out the window.
The whole school was stuck to the ceiling, yelling at me.
Then I remembered. Never watch her face. Watch the ceiling.
Rose, are you happy right now?
No! It's not like I like you or anything.
The roof came off the school.
New rule. You sit next to her. Forever.
